result.topic_en: Logarithmic transformation formulas for the eta-function under modular substitutions (ω, 2ω, ω/2, (1+ω)/2) involving symbols (m,n), from which expressions for log k, log k' and log 2K/π are derived in three parity cases of m and n.
result.transcription:
19.
$0 = \log \eta(\omega) + 2A + B \;(+\frac{\pi i}{12 n}\{(m,n) - m\})$
$0 = \log \eta(2\omega) + A + B + \frac{1}{2}\log 2 + \frac{\pi i}{12 n}\{(2m,n) - 2m\}$ wenn $n \equiv 1$ (mod. 2)
$0 = \log \eta(2\omega) + 4A + B \quad + \frac{\pi i}{6 n}\{(m,\frac{n}{2}) - m\}$ " $n \equiv 0$ "
$0 = \log \eta(\frac{\omega}{2}) + A + B \quad + \frac{\pi i}{24 n}\{(m,2n) - m\}$ " $m \equiv 1$ "
$0 = \log \eta(\frac{\omega}{2}) + 4A + B - \frac{1}{2}\log 2 + \frac{\pi i}{12 n}\{(\frac{m}{2},n) - \frac{m}{2}\}$ " $m \equiv 0$ "
$0 = \log \eta(\frac{1+\omega}{2}) + A + B \quad + \frac{\pi i}{24 n}\{(m+n,2n) - m - n\}$ " $m+n \equiv 1$ "
$0 = \log \eta(\frac{1+\omega}{2}) + 4A + B - \frac{1}{2}\log 2 + \frac{\pi i}{12 n}\{(\frac{m+n}{2},n) - \frac{m+n}{2}\}$ " $m+n \equiv 0$
und hieraus:
I wenn $m \equiv n \equiv 1$ mod 2
$2(2m,n) + (m,2n) + 2(\frac{m+n}{2},n) = 6(m,n)$
$\log k = 12A - 2\log 2 + \frac{m\pi i}{2n} + \frac{\pi i}{3n}\{(\frac{m+n}{2},n) - (2m,n)\}$
$\log k' = 12A - 2\log 2 \quad + \frac{\pi i}{6n}\{2(\frac{m+n}{2},n) - (m,2n)\}$
$\log \frac{2K}{\pi} = -12A - 2B + 2\log 2 \quad + \frac{\pi i}{6n}\{(m,n) - 2(\frac{m+n}{2},n)\}$
II wenn $m \equiv 0$, $n \equiv 1$ (mod. 2)
$2(2m,n) + 2(\frac{m}{2},n) + (m+n,2n) = 6(m,n)$
$\log k = \quad \frac{m\pi i}{2n} + \frac{\pi i}{6n}\{(m+n,2n) - 2(2m,n)\}$
$\log k' = -12A + 2\log 2 \quad + \frac{\pi i}{6n}\{(m+n,2n) - 2(\frac{m}{2},n)\}$
$\log \frac{2K}{\pi} = -2B \quad + \frac{\pi i}{6n}\{(m,n) - (m+n,2n)\}$
III wenn $m \equiv 1$, $n \equiv 0$ (mod. 2)
[-$\log k$ =-] $4(m,\frac{n}{2}) + (m,2n) + (m+n,2n) = 6(m,n)$
$\log k = -12A + 2\log 2 + \frac{m\pi i}{2n} + \frac{\pi i}{6n}\{(m+n,2n) - 4(m,\frac{n}{2})\}$
$\log k' = \quad \frac{\pi i}{6n}\{(m+n,2n) - (m,2n)\}$
$\log \frac{2K}{\pi} = -2B \quad + \frac{\pi i}{6n}\{(m,n) - (m+n,2n)\}$

449.
H Weber scrips.
